bloques.titulo: Temporary and spatial prepositions with genitive

filas: Exige genitivo: des Monats / eines Jahres

texto: The formal correspondence also uses time circumstantial supplements in genitive without preposition: **eines Tages** (one day), **letzten Endes** (at the end of the day), **heutigen Datums** (today).

intro: In public calls, administrative time limits, contracts and notarial notices, temporary and institutional details are often structured by prepositions of genitiva such as **innerhalb** (within the time limit of), **außerhalb** (outside of) and **während** (during the course of).
